verdict.rationale: Missive's docs show snoozing hides a conversation until a chosen time and then returns it to the Inbox, and it can be triggered by swipe or the ⌘/Ctrl+K command bar. That covers the snooze half of the story. Nothing in the pack shows a follow-up reminder that resurfaces a thread only if nobody replies; snooze is purely time-based. Missing for 10: reply-conditional follow-up reminders, any evidence of resurfacing on no-reply, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
